To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the success of an ERP project is influenced by a variety of factors that can be divided into three main areas: (1) the organizational context of an ERP project, (2) the technical context, and (3) the project management of an ERP project.
ERP projects within SMEs are characterized by a high degree of importance of technical factors and a low degree of importance of organizational factors.
the CSFs of ERP projects in small companies are the same as those in large-scale projects, with the exception that technological factors gain much more importance.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the question of whether the factors that are considered to be the critical success factors of ERP projects in large companies also affect the success of ERP systems in SMEs, and if so, to what extent.
the question which factors have a significant effect on the success of ERP implementations within SMEs.
the identification of CSFs in SMEs.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the factors that have been found as CSFs for ERP projects in general also have a high relevance for SMEs, but the factors that are most important differ between the two types of companies.
the CSFs of ERP projects in large companies are also important in SMEs.
the CSFs of ERP projects in smaller enterprises are the same as in larger enterprises.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the success of an ERP project depends on a variety of factors, but the most critical ones are the ones that are most specific to the individual company.
the factors that are most important for the success of ERP systems in SMEs are the Organizational fit, ERP system tests and the ERP system's technical features.
SMEs should pay more attention to the organizational fit of the system as well as the ERP tests, which are often neglected.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SMEs need a different approach for ERP projects compared to larger companies.
SMEs need to pay more attention to the organizational fit of the ERP systems they are implementing, as well as to the testing of those systems.
ERP projects in SME are more complex than previously thought.
